description: Sri Lanka Customs - The Rates of Exchange effective from 11.05.2020 to 17.05.2020
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter. The notification is issued under statutory authority and creates binding compliance requirements.
